components.name: Selected Segment
components.description: The active option in a compact peer-view switcher.
components.css: .ds-segment { border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-accent, #0f9f9a); color: #000; padding: 6px 16px; font: 600 14px/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 200ms ease-out; } .ds-segment:hover { background: var(--color-accent-hover, #14b8ad); } .ds-segment:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #0f9f9a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: The standard local and remote title search control.
components.css: .ds-search { width: 320px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-subtle, #26393f); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-surface-raised, #101b20); color: var(--color-text-primary, #f4f0e8); padding: 10px 12px; font: 400 14px/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 200ms ease-out, box-shadow 200ms ease-out; } .ds-search::placeholder { color: var(--color-text-muted, #6f8384); } .ds-search:focus-visible { border-color: var(--color-accent, #0f9f9a); outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent, #0f9f9a) 35%, transparent); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: A compact status, genre, or streaming filter.
components.css: .ds-chip { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent, #0f9f9a) 45%, transparent); border-radius: 6px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent, #0f9f9a) 15%, transparent); color: var(--color-accent, #0f9f9a); padding: 6px 12px; font: 600 12px/1.3 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 200ms ease-out; } .ds-chip:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent, #0f9f9a) 22%, transparent); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #0f9f9a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Poster Card
components.description: Artwork-first collection card with compact title metadata.
components.css: .ds-card { width: 180px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-subtle, #26393f); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-surface-raised, #101b20); color: var(--color-text-primary, #f4f0e8); box-shadow: 0 14px 40px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.16); transition: transform 200ms ease-out, border-color 200ms ease-out; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent, #0f9f9a) 45%, var(--color-border-subtle, #26393f)); } .ds-poster { aspect-ratio: 2 / 3; background: var(--color-surface-overlay, #17272d); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 12px 12px 0; font: 600 14px/1.35 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card p { margin: 4px 12px 12px; color: var(--color-text-muted, #6f8384); font: 400 12px/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #0f9f9a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: The selected destination in the desktop rail or mobile bar.
components.html: Movies
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent, #0f9f9a) 20%, transparent); border-radius: 8px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent, #0f9f9a) 15%, transparent); color: var(--color-accent, #0f9f9a); padding: 10px 12px; font: 500 14px/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 200ms ease-out; } .ds-nav svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-nav:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent, #0f9f9a) 22%, transparent); } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #0f9f9a); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Watchlist combines the concentration of a private screening room with the precision of a personal database. Dark, subtly teal surfaces recede behind poster artwork, while compact controls and clear state changes keep collection management fast. The interface is restrained rather than theatrical: atmosphere comes from artwork and tonal depth, not oversized decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Artwork-first cards on quiet, layered surfaces.
One signal-teal accent reserved for selection, focus, and primary state.
Familiar navigation, tabs, filters, and responsive structural changes.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Use the accent for current selection, focus, progress, and primary actions—not as ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Compact Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Strengthen hierarchy through weight before increasing type size; product controls should never feel promotional.

rules.name: The Quiet Depth Rule
rules.body: Borders define structure; shadows support separation without becoming visible decoration.

dos: Do use 6–8px geometry and one-pixel borders consistently.
Do preserve the current compact style when adding or reorganizing product surfaces.
Do let posters and backdrops carry most of the visual atmosphere.
Do maintain WCAG 2.2 AA contrast, visible focus, keyboard operation, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't make a large redesign; preserve the current compact style.
Don't imitate a generic streaming-service home screen with oversized promotional rails.
Don't add decorative UI that competes with poster artwork or slows collection management.
Don't use glassmorphism, gradient text, colored side-stripe borders, or arbitrary radii.
